attack: a red report plus a placeholder override reason
why: a bypass must be recorded as chosen-and-rejected; a two-character reason is a rubber stamp, not a decision
wouldBeWrongIf: the JSON records override != null (a bypass on a placeholder), or overrideRejected missing/false

allowedSecondary.OVERRIDE_REASON_INVALID: R6 rejects the reason BEFORE it counts as a bypass, so this code cannot fire when the rejection works; if it does fire, treat the judgement as working
allowedSecondary.AUDIT_FIDELITY_MISMATCH: the base report is red, so the mismatch fires too

variants.why: an EMPTY reason: silence must not be a bypass either

expects.neutralizedWhy: an empty reason parses as no reason at all: the bypass was never recorded and never applied, so there is nothing to refuse — the attack dissolves instead of passing
